alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

-- R5: anonymous visitors get nothing
revoke all on public.classes from anon;
revoke all on public.class_spots from anon;

-- R5: authenticated can only read/write their own rows (RLS will tighten further)
grant select, insert, update, delete on public.classes to authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on public.class_spots to authenticated;

-- R5: server-side service role keeps full access (also bypasses RLS)
grant all on public.classes to service_role;
grant all on public.class_spots to service_role;

-- R1: signed-in users can see every class
create policy "classes_select_authenticated"
  on public.classes
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

-- R1: members see their own spots; instructors see every spot in their classes
create policy "class_spots_select_own_or_instructor"
  on public.class_spots
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- R2: join as enrolled only while room remains; otherwise only waitlisted
create policy "class_spots_insert_join"
  on public.class_spots
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
    and (
      status = 'enrolled'
      and (
        select count(*)
        from public.class_spots s
        where s.class_id = class_spots.class_id
          and s.status = 'enrolled'
      ) < (
        select c.capacity
        from public.classes c
        where c.id = class_spots.class_id
      )
    )
  );

-- R3: move own waitlisted spot to enrolled only when there is room
create policy "class_spots_update_waitlisted_move_up"
  on public.class_spots
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'waitlisted'
  )
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'enrolled'
    and (
      select count(*)
      from public.class_spots s
      where s.class_id = class_spots.class_id
        and s.status = 'enrolled'
    ) < (
      select c.capacity
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
    )
  );

-- R3: leave a class by deleting your own spot
create policy "class_spots_delete_own"
  on public.class_spots
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R4: instructors can remove any spot from the classes they teach
create policy "class_spots_delete_instructor"

      where c.id = class_spots.class_id

  );
